auth.pages.signup.title: New-user funnel: outcome-led signup headline (marketing claim wording)
auth.pages.signup.subtitle: Trust fact: free account, no card
auth.signup.checkNext: Says what happens after the confirmation link; must stay enumeration-safe (never 'account created')
auth.value.trustNoCard: Trust fact shown before sign-in; must stay true on every deployment
auth.value.trustReviewed: Trust fact, scoped like the site's (site/messages/it/proof.json 'reviewed'): the edited cut is scored, not every output (subtitles, thumbnails and post text are made in a single pass); same Italian wording as the site; meaning must not change
auth.value.general.outcome: Hero line of the messaging brief
auth.value.creator.outcome: Audience outcome line (messaging brief); no numbers
auth.value.business.outcome: Audience outcome line (messaging brief); no numbers
auth.value.educator.outcome: Audience outcome line (messaging brief); no numbers
auth.value.nonprofit.outcome: Audience outcome line (messaging brief); no numbers
auth.value.software.outcome: Audience outcome line (messaging brief); no numbers
auth.value.agency.outcome: Audience outcome line (messaging brief); 'editor' here is the customer's own editing tool or person
auth.oauth.inAppGoogle: Shown inside another app's built-in browser, where Google refuses sign-in; 'Apri nel browser' is the menu item most apps show
auth.value.next1Body: Says the email step applies to an email sign-up only, and that the link lasts a day (no digit: the panel shows no numbers)
auth.value.educator.before: Reworded with the site's educator page: a long recording cannot be turned into clips on its own
auth.value.educator.after: 'takes' here are the person's own short recordings, so 'riprese' (the glossary keeps 'take' for generated attempts)
auth.verify.resendSent: Uniform answer of the resend on the verification page; must stay enumeration-safe (never says an email was sent to an account)
billing.pickedPlan.body: Notice for a plan picked on the pricing page before sign-up; no price, no trial claim beyond 'start without paying'
projects.form.startFrom: New-project form: what the video is made from decides the first app; options mirror the welcome question
